title: Reunion with An Miaoyi
summary: News that Ye Fan has destroyed an ancient family spreads. Unseen figures take an interest in the Holy Body; Yao Xi and the Holy Son of Yaoguang react; and a surviving Wang Teng (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven) swears to an unnamed ancient-clan backer that he will do anything to kill Ye Fan. Ji Ziyue arrives at the barbarian tribe and meets Ye Tong. He tells her Ye Fan and Li Tian have gone into the far Northern Plains after Tu Fei, who hasn't been seen for sixteen or seventeen years, and passes on Ye Fan's message that she should quietly gather information in Nanling and wait for him. Dongfang Man tells the recovering Li Heishui that Ye Fan has promised to take him to kill Zi Tianfeng. Hunting Wang survivors for news, Ye Fan cripples their cultivation instead of killing them, then heads for the North Pole, birthplace of the immortal light, which the Barbarian King has warned could kill even Saints. In the snow he hears sutra chanting and finds An Miaoyi (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven), who no longer knows him: she is a part of herself she split off, and she waited only to meet him once and fulfil the other self's wish. Ye Fan fights her to reach the An Miaoyi he knew, and her move creates a small world.

changes: An Miaoyi is found in the North Pole ice fields chanting sutras, not in a temple.
The fight is a real duel, not only a divine-sense battle; her attack creates a small world.
Added Wang Teng's survival and vow, Ji Ziyue meeting Ye Tong, and Ye Fan sparing the Wang survivors.
flags: 00:40–01:10: the opening voices ('the one I've waited twelve years for', 'worth killing myself') aren't identified.
02:16–02:50: Wang Teng's patron (who talks about 'my clan's effort' and calls madmen more interesting) isn't identified.
04:43: 'kamu Fei' is a machine-translation artefact for 'Tu Fei' (the fansub mistranslates 'Ye'/'Tu' as 'kamu'/'Kamu penggemar' throughout).
11:57: Li Tian's joke 'dan Anda masih mengatakan tidak ada hubungan dengan sekte tersebut?' is out of place.
